text:
jess: Heads-up: Zephyr-v2 + realtime-mux is going GA on Hosted API next Tue. This adds session affinity for tool-calls and a new header to advertise per-org stream quotas. Details follow. :confetti_ball:

luca: Great 94 staged? will toolcall-v2 be mandatory?

jess: Staged rollout. Toolcall-v2 will be opt-in during preview, then mandatory for new orgs at GA. Legacy toolcall remains available for 60 days for existing tenants.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout to prod-us-west-2 started at 2026-05-10T22:01:01Z 94 canary id c-1979754321

rita: What are default stream quotas and how do orgs request increases?

jess: Defaults: trial=10 concurrent streams, standard=80, enterprise=400. Increases via Support; Dedicated/Private customers control via their deployment config. New headers: X-RW-Stream-Quota (advertised live quota) and X-RW-Session-ID for affinity. 429 responses include Retry-After.

legal: FYI: this release enables request-level audit logging for tool calls on Hosted API. CSMs must notify customers where required by contract. Privacy review complete.

luca: Any canary perf numbers yet? p50/p95 and token-cost delta?

jess: Canary snapshot: p50 ~42ms, p95 ~220ms for short-turn dialogs; token-cost delta ~+3% (session metadata). Full perf sheet: https://go.redwood/internal/releases/zephyr-v2 (internal).

devx-bot: devx: New SDK releases published 94 go@1.8.0, py@3.0.0, js@4.0.0 include realtime-mux, session helpers, and updated retry helpers. See changelogs.

rita: Metering / billing changes? Growth needs to know how to report usage.

jess: Billing units unchanged for tokens. We add stream_units for metering; multiplexed streams count separately. Growth export with delta estimates will be provided tomorrow. Ping @growth-team for follow-ups.

luca: Rollback plan if error rates spike?

jess: Auto-fallback to legacy pool if errors >5% sustained for 10m, then manual rollback possible within ~20m. Ops playbook: https://go.redwood/internal/playbooks/realtime-rollback. We'll monitor with a dedicated dashboard.

jess: Rollout timeline:
- May 12: Org opt-in preview opens
- May 19: US GA
- May 26: EU / APAC GA
- Jul 01: Default enablement for newly-created orgs (existing orgs preserved until opt-out)

jess: Action items: add customer-facing notes in #support, CSM one-pager will be published tomorrow, tag me for urgent exceptions.

luca: Ack. I'll coordinate warmup with infra and sched ops for capacity increases. :white_check_mark:
